faqs.q: What is Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray and what is it used for?
faqs.a: Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray is a mineral oil, polyisobutene (pib) dispersion thickened with none with MoS2, graphite as solid lubricant. Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray is used for initial lubrication of chains with hollow pins equipped with grease nipples (e.g., high tenter clamp chains in the textile industry and conveyor chains in food sterilizer units).

faqs.q: What is the operating temperature range of Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray?
faqs.a: Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray has a service temperature range of 0 °C to 160 °C, per the DuPont technical data sheet. See the linked datasheet for the full test conditions.

faqs.q: What is Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray made from?

DuPont lists its composition as: mineral oil, polyisobutene (pib) technology; none thickener; MoS2, graphite solid lubricant. Its published properties include appearance black.

faqs.q: What NLGI grade is Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray and what does that mean?
faqs.a: Molykote 1122 Chain Grease Spray is NLGI grade 2-3. NLGI grades classify grease consistency from 000 (semi-fluid) to 6 (very hard): a lower number is softer and pumps more easily, and a higher number stays put in an open or vertical point.
